I would recommend checking the implementation of the `Base32` class to ensure that the encoding and decoding functions correctly handle stream skipping without interfering with the underlying stream.

If the encoding and decoding logic in the `Base32` class seems correct, then the issue might be within how the `Base32InputStream` class manages the stream operations. Further investigation into how the `Base32InputStream` utilizes the `Base32` encoding logic would be necessary to pinpoint the exact cause of the reported behavior.
